summary: Side menu for the app's main sections. Only its imports and menu item shape were visible in this review, so the rest of its behaviour is unclear.
purpose: Lets the user move between the main sections of the app.
why: Likely reason: a fixed menu keeps the main sections reachable from any screen. The full reason is not visible.
how: From the visible parts: loads the store and the logo, uses persona-based wording, and defines each menu entry with a tab id, label, icon, and optional badge with a colour. Lines 20 to 182, which draw the menu and handle clicks, were not visible.
inputs: The tab list from the store (TabType), the persona from the profile, and clicks.
outputs: Menu entries. Choosing an entry is expected to change the active tab, but this is not confirmed in the visible lines.
risks: Menu entries must use valid tab names from the store, or clicking them will not lead to a screen. Most of the file was not visible.
debug: If a menu entry leads nowhere, check its tab id against the store's tab list. If the labels look wrong, check the persona helper. If the menu will not open on phones, check the mobile menu state in the store.
